title: TSNSMP
description: Join our cozy survival SMP — build, explore, and make friends with a welcoming (but slightly unhinged) community. If you feel you would fit in! MAKE SURE TO APPLY!
body:
# TSNSMP

A whitelisted, community-driven survival SMP built for players who actually want to play — no client mods required.

---
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/IqeSeq3w_A8" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## What is TSNSMP?

TSNSMP is a semi-vanilla survival SMP running a suite of server-side quality-of-life mods. Players join with a completely vanilla client and still get enhanced chat, tablist, live streaming indicators, custom name colors, and more — all handled server-side.

---

## Content Creator Friendly

TSNSMP has built-in support for streamers and content creators. Live status, clickable stream links, and real-time indicators are built right into the server experience — but you absolutely **don't** need to be a content creator to join and enjoy the server.

---

## No Mods Needed

All custom features are handled server-side. Join with a **standard vanilla Minecraft client** — no modpack, no setup, no hassle.
Although we do reccommend simple voice chat as it is just so much more fun like that!

---

## Friendly Community

We have a strict whitelisting policy, if any of the members dont like a member we wont add them. There are also no claims since we trust our players.

---


## How to Join

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **This is an 18+ server.** You must be 18 or older to apply. Exceptions require thorough vouching by existing members.

Applications are handled exclusively through our website:

**[tsnsmp.online](https://www.tsnsmp.online)**

---

*See you on the server!*
